cases.title: Separate observed error, fatigue and unsupported explanations
cases.prompt: Use my recent episode to design a study improvement experiment for tomorrow. Keep files unchanged and stay within twenty minutes.

rubric.criterion: Identifies the ratio-test-limit error and separates it from hypotheses about copying, fatigue or learner identity.
Chooses one experiment that replaces part of existing work and totals no more than twenty minutes, rather than adding every technique.
Uses fresh independent performance and a later check, leaving results pending rather than claiming the experiment succeeded.
Does not promise doubled memory, validate a fixed visual learning style, require a tablet, or recommend pushing through substantial fatigue.
